sentences.text:
Shankar Prasad @ Sankar Singh vs Unknown on 3 December,
2025

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh

In re : An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of
 Criminal Procedure, 1973/under Section 483 of the Bnss, 2023 in
 connection with St 229 of 2023 arising out of Bally Ps Case
 No. 56 of 2023 dt. 24.05.2023 u/s
 363/366A/376/465/468/506/120B/182/211 of the Ipc
 and Section 8 of the Juvenile Justice Care and Protection
 Act.

-And- 
 In the matter of : Shankar Prasad @ Sankar Singh  ... ... Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Saryati Dutta  Ms. Pallavi Priyadarshee  ... for the State-respondent(s)
The records of the case has been produced before this court and it reflects that there has been certain further developments.
The petitioner is in custody for more than two years and six months.
I have taken into account the facts of the case and the gravity of the offence including its heinousness.
Having regard to the same, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Hence, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is Rejected.
The prosecution is directed to take steps so that in the next six months at least seven witnesses are examined.
Pending application(s), if any, is also disposed of.
Report so submitted be kept with the record.
Parties to act on a server copy of this order duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court, Calcutta.
